stem: 以下哪个项目最有可能被视为监管机构有效监管制度的一部分？

options.A: 开展现场和非现场审查及国际合作，并可运用一系列制裁手段和外联措施

stem_en: Which of the following programs would most likely be considered part of an effective supervision regime for a regulator?

options_en.A: Onsite and offsite reviews, cooperating on an international basis, with access to a range of sanctions and outreach
options_en.B: Onsite and offsite reviews, cooperating on an international and domestic basis, with access to a range of sanctions and outreach
options_en.C: Offsite reviews, cooperating on a domestic basis, with access to a range of sanctions and outreach
options_en.D: Onsite reviews, cooperating on an international and domestic basis, without outreach or access to a range of sanctions
